summary: Takeda filed a Form 6-K reporting the appointment of Julie Kim as Representative Director, President and CEO, following the 150th Annual General Meeting of Shareholders. The transition was the final step of an 18-month CEO succession plan. Former CEO Christophe Weber retired from the company and the Board. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is involved; this is a routine CEO transition reported as a foreign private issuer. The filing details new director appointments and retirements. What to watch: continued execution under new leadership and pipeline progress.
